# Motion animators (draw on, motion path, morph, gradient, mask/clip, blur)

- Kind: `editor`
- Category: `vector`
- Slug: `vector/animators`

## Summary

One-click animators in Motion: each adds keyframe tracks to the selected layer from the playhead to the end, as one undo step.

## Details

- `drawOn` (Draw on): Draw the stroke from start to end (stroke dash offset).
- `motionPath` (Motion path): Move the layer along a path. Pick a path or draw one with the pen.
- `morph` (Morph): Morph this path into another shape. Pick the target shape.
- `gradient` (Gradient): Animate the colours of this layer's gradient (one track per stop).
- `maskClip` (Mask/Clip): Animate the layer's mask or clip shape with its own tracks.
- `blur` (Blur): Blur the layer in over time.
Draw on needs an outline shape (path, line, polyline, polygon, rect, ellipse); a layer without a stroke gets one. Motion path follows a guide path; Morph needs a second shape as the target.
Animators run from the playhead to the end of the timeline; adjust their keyframes afterwards in the timeline.
